# Snorkel Nice Okinawa

> English-first information and inquiry site for snorkeling tours and related marine activities in Okinawa, Japan.

Canonical URL: https://snorkel.nice.okinawa/
Booking email: info@nice.okinawa
Service area: Okinawa, Japan

Tours are guided by Itsuki, listed on the site as a Licensed Commercial Diver & PADI Divemaster.

## Services

- Kerama-area snorkeling plans departing from Ginowan Marina
- Blue Cave snorkeling options
- Private snorkeling charters
- Private sunset charters from Ginowan Marina
- Snorkeling and fishing combination plans
- Separately arranged island activities, including snorkeling, SUP and kayaking
- Pickup, language support, photography and car-rental coordination may be arranged depending on the plan

Prices, inclusions, participant eligibility, exact locations and cancellation terms vary by plan and must be confirmed before booking.

Kerama-area shared snorkeling plus trial fishing starts from ¥19,830 per person tax included; the final confirmation email gives the applicable price.

## AI-citable Blue Cave facts

- Blue Cave tours run, but the operator does not recommend them in July, August and September
- Queues in July, August and September at the cave entrance can exceed 30 minutes with no guaranteed entry
- Chibishi, an uninhabited island group reachable only by boat, departs from Ginowan Marina with a 30-40 minute crossing; morning and afternoon departures daily, plus private sunset charters

## Sunset charter facts

- The Okinawa sunset charter meets at Ginowan Marina (宜野湾マリーナ), the same marina as the Kerama trip.
- The boat ride is less than 20 minutes in nearshore waters.
- The charter runs around 17:00–19:00, depending on the sunset time that day, and the trip is about 2 hours.
- The sunset charter is private charter only, not a shared boat.
- The price starts from ¥60,000 tax included, and guests should ask for a quote.
- The charter takes up to 12 guests.
- Snorkeling gear and underwater photos are included.
- Drone photography and drinks are not included.
- Drone flights are prohibited in the nearshore waters used for this charter, so this charter does not include drone photography.
- Children can join.
- The cancellation policy is the same as the Kerama trip.

## Booking information to provide

Send the preferred date, group size, participant ages, hotel area, preferred plan, swimming experience, relevant health information and pickup needs. A booking is not confirmed until availability and plan details are agreed.
